system.schemaDirty: The last migration did not finish cleanly — take a backup and contact support before updating.
system.updateIntro: Updates run on the server itself so the whole stack (panel, RADIUS, database) moves together. The updater takes a backup first and rolls back automatically if the new version fails to start.

system.updateStep3: Wait for “Update complete and healthy.” — then reload this page and check the version above.
system.updateSafety: Safe by design: a pre-update backup is taken automatically, and a failed update rolls back to the previous version on its own.
system.updateOffline: No internet on the server? Copy the release bundle over and run:
